summary:
Comprehensive architectural implementation plan to achieve full 1:1 parity between Africa's Talking live telephony calls and the Phone Simulator:
1. Complete elimination of unsupported <Redirect> VoiceXML tags across all telephony webhooks in favor of direct, zero-latency inline VoiceXML state transitions.
2. Complete eradication of English TTS voice interference in the Akan Twi flow by fixing Twi studio recording manifest extensions (.mp3 vs .m4a), enforcing strict Akan Twi audio playback, and utilizing native Twi digit concatenation (hwee, baako, mmienu...).
3. Full dual-modality enablement (keypad DTMF + speech fallback recording) at every step of the call so voice and keypad work seamlessly on live mobile networks.
